name: Val Ni Daal
instructions: 1. Sauté cumin, garlic, and onions. 2. Add sprouted beans and water. 3. Simmer with minimal spices until the beans are tender. 4. Garnish with coriander.
description: Earthy field beans, transformed into a nutritious and aromatic tribal staple.
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
